## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a relevant issue if available.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results, including failures or limitations.
For UI changes, include screenshots. For operational changes, include configuration or migration steps.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] This PR targets `main` and addresses one focused change.
- [ ] Documentation is in English and reflects the final behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, generated builds, or runtime files are included.
- [ ] Relevant checks have been run, or missing checks are explained above.

The sole maintainer, @francescocirulli, reviews and decides whether to accept this contribution.
